official.deadline_note: No single national deadline is published: each French institution sets its own internal date for submitting Eiffel candidates; the Eiffel 2027 regulations PDF is published on the programme page.
official.application_cycle: Annual campaign; Regulations Eiffel 2027 published on the programme page
official.status_note: The programme page publishes the 2027 regulations; applications are submitted by institutions during the annual campaign, so applicants must ask their target French institution for its internal date.
official.tuition_coverage_note: For both elements of the program, tuition fees are not covered by the France Excellence Eiffel program.
benefits: Master's level: monthly allowance of EUR 1,200 (from January 2026)
Doctorate level: monthly stipend of EUR 2,100 (from January 2026)
eligibility: Master's and Doctoral degree programmes only

Priority study areas: biology and health; ecological transition; mathematics and digital; engineering sciences; history, French language and civilization; law and political science; economics and management
Applications are submitted exclusively by French higher education institutions
requirements: A French higher education institution must accept, support and submit the application - applications sent directly by students or by foreign institutions are declared ineligible
documents: Determined by the host French institution; the programme page directs applicants to the institution's international relations office for procedures and deadlines
coverage: Monthly allowance of EUR 1,200 at Master's level (EUR 2,100 at Doctorate level) from January 2026
International transportation, national transportation, insurance, housing searches, cultural activities
Tuition fees are not covered for either element of the programme
application_method: Contact Campus France in your country of origin or the French Embassy's Cooperation and Cultural Action Department for guidance
Contact the international relations department of a French institution to learn its procedures and submission deadline
The institution accepts your candidacy and submits the application online via the dedicated Campus France website
official.application_route: Institution-nominated only - students cannot apply directly
official.study_mode: Full-time degree programme at a French higher education institution
official.citizenship_residency: Aimed at foreign students in degree programmes at French institutions
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the programme trains future foreign decision-makers
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Seven priority study areas spanning science and technology and humanities and social sciences
official.research_requirement: Doctorate level: a joint doctoral programme (joint supervision of dissertation and/or dual degree) in partnership with a partner institution abroad
official.duration: Master's: maximum 12 months when enrolling in M2, 24 months for M1, 36 months for an engineering degree. Doctorate: 12 to 36 months starting 1 September of the award year
official.description: The France Excellence Eiffel scholarship program is a tool developed by the French Ministry of Foreign Affairs to help French institutions of higher education attract the best foreign students to Master's and Doctoral degree programmes in priority fields.
official.program_type: Government scholarship programme administered by Campus France

verification.notes: Campus France programme page fetched live in English and French; both levels' allowances, benefit list and the tuition exclusion are confirmed on the awarding body's own domain. The Eiffel 2027 regulations PDF is published on the page but could not be text-extracted (binary PDF), so its internal details are not quoted here; note the French-language page (updated September 2025) still shows EUR 2,000 at Doctorate level while the current English page shows EUR 2,100.

applicant_utility.summary: Nothing about Eiffel can be started by emailing Campus France with a CV: a French institution has to want you badly enough to spend one of its own Eiffel nominations on you, so the real application is getting admitted to a French Master's or doctoral programme first. Once an institution backs you, the money is a monthly allowance - EUR 1,200 at Master's level and EUR 2,100 at Doctorate level from January 2026 - plus covered international and national transport, insurance, housing-search support and cultural activities, but tuition stays yours to pay. Because submission is institutional, your deadline is whatever date each institution's international relations office sets internally, which is usually weeks before any national round.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Strong applicants already targeting a French Master's or doctoral place who can persuade the institution to nominate them.
application_readiness_checklist: Shortlist institutions in the seven priority fields and contact their international relations offices directly for their internal Eiffel deadline
Secure admission or a strong institutional commitment before asking for an Eiffel nomination
Budget for tuition separately - the allowance does not cover it
Confirm with the institution whether you would be enrolled in M1, M2, an engineering degree or a joint doctorate, since this sets the maximum duration
Never send a direct application to Campus France - it will be declared ineligible
common_rejection_risks: Emailing a personal application to Campus France instead of securing an institutional submission - declared ineligible
Proposing a programme outside the seven priority study areas
Missing the institution's internal date because you waited for a central deadline that does not exist
Assuming tuition is included and having no funding plan for fees
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Tuition fees are excluded at both levels, along with the CVEC and any programme-specific charges not covered by the listed services
document_audit: The dossier is assembled by the institution, so your job is to supply it early - transcripts, CV and project documents in French or English
Institution requirements differ: ask specifically which documents they need to complete the Eiffel file
alerts: Applications sent directly by students or foreign institutions are declared ineligible - there is no self-service route
Duration is capped by entry level (12 months M2, 24 months M1, 36 months engineering), so an M1 entrant gets two years only if the programme requires it
The allowance rates stepped up from January 2026 - older figures circulating online understate the award
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Gain an institutional commitment or admission, the institution submits online through Campus France's dedicated site, and the award starts on 1 September of the award year for doctoral candidates.
